card.name: Light and radioactivity units
card.fires_on: Units of light output (lm, luminous, color rendering) and radioactivity (MBq, uptake) right after a number or measurement term. It fires partway through the unit word or just before it.

modes.label: Radioactivity doses
modes.description: The MB part of MBq in radiopharmaceutical dose ranges, or uptake in iodine labels.
